subject: MAP: hosting & region tradeoffs — hosted vs dedicated vs private
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medline.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T09:12:00Z
Subject: MAP & hosting decision — timeline to close

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're ready to lock down a mutual action plan so we can make a hosting decision and get procurement moving. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm recommended path for our use case (patient-facing assistant + document retrieval) — is Hosted sufficient or will we need Dedicated/Private given PHI and residency needs?
- Proposed evaluation plan with milestones and an expected close date — we have a tight window and want to close before our board meeting on Aug 2.
- Any necessary security artifacts and a procurement pack for our legal team.

I attached our internal MAP template (Medline_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a short list of residency questions. Can you propose a two-week evaluation plan and a target date for sign-off?

Jordan
Head of AI Platforms
MedlineAI

Attachment: Medline_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP & hosting decision — timeline to close

Jordan — really appreciate the clarity. Draft MAP and proposed evaluation plan below. I've attached a one-pager that summarizes tradeoffs and a SOC2 scope doc for procurement.

High-level recommendation (based on what we saw):
- Short answer: Hosted is viable for a production pilot if you are comfortable with Hosted in US regions and using our VPC peering + data controls.
- Recommended for next 90 days: Start on Hosted (us-east) with strict prefix caching and token limits for the pilot. Move to Dedicated if you need guaranteed GPU pool isolation or if your security team requires customer-dedicated compute. Private (on-prem) is available but will add ~8–12 weeks to onboard.

Proposed 2-week evaluation plan (MAP milestones):
1) Week 1 (eval setup, 3 days): join sandbox, configure VPC peering, ingest sample data (PII redaction guidance attached).
2) Week 1 (tests, 2 days): latency/cost baseline (ephemeral load tests), regression evals on sample prompts.
3) Week 2 (ops & security, 2 days): run SOC2 evidence checklist items, map data retention policies, confirm KMS integration.
4) Week 2 (decision & sign-off, 2 days): finalize go/no-go, procurement pack sent to Legal, schedule canary for pilot.

Target close: Jul 29, 2027 — allows procurement to circulate paperwork before your Aug 2 board meeting. If procurement needs more time we can compress the eval to 10 business days and push docs earlier.

Action items for MedlineAI:
- Confirm whether you require data to stay in a dedicated tenant (some customers sign up for Dedicated due to residency/segregation concerns).
- Share the procurement contact and any pre-existing SOC2 artifacts you need to cross-check.

We've attached: Hosted-vs-Dedicated-onepager.pdf, SOC2_scope.pdf, and a filled MAP template (Medline_MAP_v3.xlsx). Please review and let us know any blockers.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call today to walk the plan.

— Grace
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Hosted-vs-Dedicated-onepager.pdf (PDF, 18KB); SOC2_scope.pdf (PDF, 120KB); Medline_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T08:31:00Z
Subject: Internal: quick notes on pricing/config for MedlineAI

Folks — quick internal note after Grace's reply to Jordan. Two things to flag:

1) Pricing profile: if they start Hosted with caching we'll likely be in the $/1k tokens tier they saw in the demo; if they ask for pre-warmed Dedicated we'll need to price a minimum commitment (suggest $25k/month for a baseline N GPUs pool).
2) Residency/controls: for any PHI handling recommend we propose a Dedicated PoC as an optional parallel track — we can run the first 2 weeks on Hosted while provisioning a Dedicated pool in parallel (adds ~7–10 days). This keeps their timeline tight but gives procurement a clear option.

If procurement insists on customer-dedicated KMS/HSM, that pushes to Dedicated or Private. I'll draft the numbers for the procurement pack — Grace, do you want me to include a short appendix with cost delta estimates?

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Amit Chawla <amit@medline.ai>

Grace — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of procurement/legal questions before we can push to our CISO/legal: 

- SOC2: can you provide the exact evidence artifacts we can share (outbound links/document list)? Our legal team will want a checklist they can tick off.
- Data residency: for PHI we need to know whether Hosted (us-east) meets our policy or if vendor-dedicated tenancy is required. If Dedicated is required, can you provide an estimated lead time and a ballpark monthly fee?
- Contract: we prefer to start with a 3-month pilot with options to convert. Can you send a short procurement pack + a redline-friendly contract?

Also, can you start a DocuSign envelope for the SOW (even provisional) so procurement can see language? That speeds things up.

Thanks — cc'ing procurement mailbox.

— Amit
Senior Procurement Manager
MedlineAI
